operation.description: Enables private vulnerability reporting for a repository. The authenticated user must have admin access to the repository. For more information, see "[Privately reporting a security vulnerability](https://docs.github.com/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability)."
operation.summary: Enable private vulnerability reporting for a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/responses/no_content.description: A header with no content is returned.
